editorial: This report contains trends that have emerged for the first time today, without repeating records included in normal reports from the last 30 days.

items.title: THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC
items.summary: OpenMAIC is an immersive learning platform that simulates multi-AI agent interactions with a single click. Developed with TypeScript, this open-source tool allows users to experience an interactive classroom environment with different agent models.

items.title: k1tbyte/Wand-Enhancer
items.summary: Wand-Enhancer is a user experience and interoperability plugin developed for the game modding tool Wand (WeMod). Written in C#, this software aims to improve the functionality and interface interaction of the existing modding platform.

items.title: majd/ipatool
items.summary: Developed by Majd, ipatool is a command-line tool that allows you to search for and download application packages (IPA files) for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS from the Apple App Store. Written in Go, this tool facilitates package management processes for software developers and researchers by providing direct access to application files.

items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.summary: MiniMind is a Python project that enables training a 64-million parameter large language model from scratch in as little as two hours. It provides a practical learning environment for users with limited hardware resources to understand the operating principles of AI models.

items.title: Osmantic/ODS
items.summary: Osmantic/ODS is an open-source platform that transforms personal computers into AI servers capable of LLM inference, audio processing, and image generation. The software allows for the creation of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and intelligent agent workflows running on local hardware.

items.title: checkstyle/checkstyle
items.summary: Checkstyle is an analysis tool that helps Java programmers develop software in accordance with established coding standards. It audits code quality by supporting standards such as the Google Java Style Guide and Sun Code Conventions.

items.title: kaifcodec/user-scanner
items.summary: Developed in Python, User-Scanner is an open-source intelligence (OSINT) tool that collects data from over 465 different sources using a single email address or username. Designed for security researchers and digital footprint trackers, the software offers in-depth data analysis with a wide range of scanning vectors.

items.title: every-app/open-seo
items.summary: Open SEO offers an open-source alternative to paid search engine optimization (SEO) analysis tools (Semrush, Ahrefs). Developed with TypeScript, this software provides the essential data needed to track website performance and search visibility for free.

items.title: p-e-w/heretic
items.summary: Heretic is a Python tool that automatically removes censorship mechanisms in language models. It allows large language models (LLMs) to bypass restrictions and generate a wider range of responses.

items.title: handsomestWei/patent-disclosure-skill
items.summary: Patent disclosure skill is a Python tool that automates the processes of identifying inventive steps in patent applications and preparing technical disclosure texts. It provides support for interpreting patents clearly, tracking policy changes, and generating responses for examination processes.

items.title: pollen-robotics/microduck_rl
items.summary: microduck_rl, developed by Pollen Robotics, offers reinforcement learning training environments for the Microduck robotic platform. This Python-based library facilitates the development of robotic control algorithms on the physics-based simulation tool mjlab.

items.title: Creepy Crawlies
items.summary: Web crawlers on the internet use methods that push the boundaries of ethical limits and server loads during data collection processes. This triggers debates regarding the management of automated bot traffic, which consumes website resources and raises privacy concerns.

items.title: “I just chose words carefully”
items.summary: Prompt engineering, used to improve the outputs of artificial intelligence models, relies on the precise use of language rather than complex techniques. It is argued that using clear and selective words to guide the model's logic is more effective than technical complexity for achieving desired results.

items.title: Haiku R1/beta6 has been released
items.summary: Haiku, the open-source successor to the BeOS operating system, has been updated to version R1/beta6. The new version expands hardware driver support and offers bug fixes that improve system stability.

items.title: Hacking IKEA Furniture
items.summary: IKEA hacking, the practice of personalizing and modifying the functions of IKEA furniture, aims to redesign standard products according to user needs. This approach offers the opportunity to create unique home furnishings by using ready-made furniture parts for different purposes.

items.title: Arbitrary code execution in QubesOS via copy-to-VM error reporting backchannel
items.summary: An arbitrary code execution vulnerability has been detected in the security-focused operating system QubesOS, via the error reporting mechanism in the copy-to-VM process. This vulnerability allows attackers to bypass the system's isolation layers and perform unauthorized operations.

items.title: unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF, offered by Unsloth, is a multimodal artificial intelligence model capable of processing visual and text data. Thanks to its compressed file format (GGUF), which can run with low hardware requirements, the model allows for fast inference on local devices.

items.title: GGSS: Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering for Inference-Time Debiasing of Generative Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Geodesic-Gated Spherical Steering (GGSS) is a method that reduces demographic biases exhibited by generative vision-language models when producing outputs. This technique allows the model to explore a counterfactual bias subspace while maintaining the norm during inference-time.

items.title: Language Chain in Alignment: Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization
items.summary: Cross-lingual Ranking Preference Optimization enables large language models to perform better in languages other than English-heavy datasets. This method improves the alignment process of models in different languages by transferring preference information from English data to the target language.

items.title: Agentic Artifact Creation: Systems, Evaluation, Principles, and Opportunities
items.summary: The creation of tangible outputs such as text, code, or images from natural language by artificial intelligence systems moves generative AI processes from drafting to final product delivery. The agentic artifact creation approach focuses on the system observing its own outputs to iteratively improve the process and produce reliable results.

items.title: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
items.summary: DART-SD is a training method developed for artificial intelligence agents with multi-step tool-calling capabilities. The method aims to reduce performance losses experienced in traditional linear training processes by modeling different solution paths in complex tasks using a diamond lattice structure.

items.title: Locate Anything in Videos: Rethinking Efficient Generative Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
items.summary: Parallel Tube Decoding shortens processing time by dividing object positioning operations in videos into temporal blocks. This method aims to solve the latency and error accumulation problems encountered by traditional multimodal large language models when performing sequential processing.

items.title: Omarchy: Any User Process Can Escalate to Root
items.summary: Omarchy is a security vulnerability that allows user processes to escalate to root privileges on Linux operating systems. This vulnerability allows processes with limited privileges on the system to gain administrative access.

items.title: But where does taste come from?
items.summary: The origin of taste mechanisms that determine users' digital content preferences is shaped by individual experiences and community interactions beyond algorithmic recommendation systems. This process questions the role of technological filters in the formation of personal tastes while emphasizing the social and cultural context of original content discovery.

items.title: The U.S. is more than just the US (according to the ISO)
items.summary: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) defines the United States (US) in its country code standard as a whole, including not only its mainland but also its outlying territories. This situation requires software developers to re-evaluate the geographical scope of country codes used when processing location data through technical standards.
